rationale_bullets: Williams returns off the round's strangest offseason - retention contract, portal attempt two days later, a near-'precedent-setting court case,' then return (P6; the out-feed entry is overridden with full documentation).
The 2025 season: 79.1 PFF/461 (B10 +1 -> 80.1, ~p73 tape), 4th in B10 QB Rating, a B10-QB-best 611 rushing yards, the 16th 400-pass/100-rush FBS game ever (vs Rutgers), 25-8 overall.

The documented gap: 22-2 TD-INT in the nine wins vs 3-6 in the four losses (#2 'wins-only' rating, #12 'losses-only'; the 3-INT Michigan game) - P6 makes him 3rd-team All-B10 with 'Heisman discussion' upside if the ranked-game version arrives.
Depth: E. Brown (56.7/152 at Stanford) + true FR McMillan - thin but present.
74, H: the Becht tier - a full-volume dual-threat with a yr-2 starter bonus, graded under Maiava's 80 on tape and the big-game floor.
The room emptied: Coleman (82.1 PFF/157; 1,100 total, 17 TD) to the NFL, Mohammed (85.9/106; consecutive 100-yd November games) to Cal.

The returning hope is medically flagged: J. Washington (82.7/27) has 'top-notch explosiveness but suffered a severe injury in spring and is DOUBTFUL' (P6) - Athlon still charts him RB1; graded to the P6 note.
The imports are depth-grade: Limar (73.0/46 at Oregon; 4* pedigree, reserve usage) + Cooley (Troy) + 4* FR Bonner ('expected to be part of the rotation').
The mitigant: Williams' legs (B10-QB-best 611) and a RUN p90 offense that schemes the ground game.
50, M: zero returning healthy volume - the thinnest proven room among the round's contenders; pedigree and scheme hold it at average.
Boston (88.0 PFF/361 - 'a pure #1 receiver,' 2nd-round pick; yr3 declare) leaves the alpha void; Vines-Bright departed to ASU.
The proven riser: Roebuck (70.1/360 -> 69.1) - 42-560-7 as a freshman #2; R. Williams (68.5/24) returns from the September injury that cost him the starting job.

The influx: Moss (65.7/397 at Kennesaw, CUSA -4 -> 61.7 - full-volume production) + B. Miller (OSU Top200, no volume) + the Top200 FR trio (James/Clay/Davis) with 'six four-stars competing for spots' (P6).
TE: DeGraaf (56.0/323; 32-360) is the receiving piece; Eldridge returns to block; Q. Moore ('the best blocking TE [Fisch has] coached') expired.
56, M: one proven riser + heavy FR pedigree + a system that produced RECV p90 - graded above the aggregate (~64), below the room it replaces.

Four starters return around a Freshman All-American: Mills (70.2 PFF/589 -> 69.2; FR All-America at LG), Azzopardi (69.0/656 -> 68.0; improved yr 2), L. Hatchett (62.1/532) at C with brother G. Hatchett (66.9/775; yr4 override - 'the Hatchett brothers are back,' P6).

The one void is the best tape: LT Willis (79.9/575) to the NFL; the battle is 5* true FR Greene ('expected to start right away' - Athlon) vs 4* transfer Dieterich (72.0/763 at Sam Houston, CUSA -6 -> 66.0).
The trajectory: +50 spots in P6's OL Run Push year-over-year; RBLK graded p79.
62, M: continuity + a rising young core + credible LT options - a notch under Michigan/Nebraska's mid-60s rooms on the Willis void and FR risk.

rationale_bullets: The quiet drain: seven of the top ten '25 DL tapes are gone - Durfee (77.4/484; co-sack leader), Thompson (76.0/397), Lynch (75.1/359), Uiagalelei, Pepa expired; the five-to-P4 portal exodus (Macon/OkSt, both Parkers/Maryland, Butler/TT, C. Smith/Bama).

The anchors: E. Davis (70.8 PFF/424, B10 +10 -> 80.8) - 'the anchor at nose tackle' (P6) - and Lane (67.3/556 -> 77.3), the returning co-sack leader; injury returns Ward (63.3/277) + R. Davis add rotation.

The restock: Conley (75.7/533 at Ball St, MAC -6 -> 69.7 - real starter volume) + McClendon (Miss State; missed '25, knee) + Watts (FCS) + George (OSU depth) + Top200 FRs Colman-Brusa/Hill. 'Fall camp battles' (P6); 'should be stout' (Athlon).
62, M: two proven B10 tapes at 77-81 adjusted + one MAC starter + projection - graded at the Maryland/Minnesota tier off an RDEF p65 prior.
data_gaps: five projected two-deep spots to transfers/FRs

rationale_bullets: The consensus strength: 'overflowing with star power... the strength of the defense' (P6); 'one of the nation's best linebacking corps' (Athlon) - the strongest two-print LB endorsement of the round.

Four pedigree tapes: Alexander (68.4 PFF/518, +16 -> 84.4; 70 tkl - the full-volume floor), Manu (68.9/233 -> 84.9; yr4 override; the '24 star, injury-shortened - 'should push for All-Big Ten'), Al-Uqdah (64.1/152 -> 80.1; original starter back from injury), Rainey-Sale (67.8/266 -> 83.8; Top100 LB/edge wildcard).
Bryant (66.6/520) left for USC - absorbed by the depth.
LB caution applied: all four ride the +16 offset from 64-69 raw; two are injury-shortened samples (the Rojas pattern, pedigree-corroborated); Alexander's full volume is the trust anchor.
72, M: cautioned from the ~p85 paper aggregate - between PSU's 68 and Indiana's 77, on print consensus + depth of pedigree.

'The back seven remains elite' (P6). The returning core is young and graded: McLaughlin (70.7 PFF/842, +6 -> 76.7) - 'Defensive MVP,' All-B10 HM, team-high tackles, two defensive TDs; Clark (74.7/387 -> 80.7) at nickel; Dillard-Allen (71.6/377 -> 77.6; Freshman All-American - Athlon); Robinson (67.9/371 -> 73.9; Top200 with 'first-round traits').
The departures are real but absorbed: the nation's tallest CB duo (Prysock 77.9/810 + T. Davis 67.2/421) expired; Esteen (65.0/658) expired; Holmes to OkSt.
The height stays: Karnley (71.6/657 at Virginia, ACC +1 -> 72.6; 6'3 ACC starter) pairs with 6'3 Robinson; the 4* FR wave (Duncan/Day/Jones) stacks behind.
72, M: five bodies at 72-81 adjusted, three of them sophomores - the Oregon-74/OSU-72 tier, with youth as both the upside and the variance.
data_gaps: safety depth behind the top four

rationale_bullets: ST rule: start at the p49 as-played SPEC and adjust: BOTH legs are imported at all-league quality - K Robles (Texas State; 2nd-team All-SBC; 21-of-23, 91.3%) and P Green (San Diego State; #6 nationally at 47.0 avg).
The departures were the weakness (Moczulski to Illinois, Zimmer to Southern Miss); coordinator Petrilli is retained.
Return game: PR Clark back; KR J. Washington carries the injury flag.
58, M: a league-average prior upgraded at both legs with coordinator continuity - the round's cleanest special-teams import job.
